# Get RSS Items From Feed

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Gets the RSS items from an RSS Feed.

## Syntax

~~~~text
getRSSItems(url: <#String (Allows Variables)#>, count: <#Number (Allows Variables) (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
getRSSItems(url: "https://www.macstories.net/feed/", count: 10)
~~~~
